description: A generic asset declaration, appraisal summary, or itemized personal-property statement for assets that do not fit a standard category, such as collectibles, jewelry, or equipment. Used to verify miscellaneous asset value.

owner_name.instruction: The full name of the person who owns the declared assets.

appraiser_or_preparer_name.instruction: The name of the appraiser, assessor, or preparer of the statement, if shown.

asset_description.instruction: A description of the itemized asset(s), such as jewelry, collectibles, or equipment.

asset_category.instruction: The general category of the asset, such as collectibles, jewelry, equipment, or other valuables.

estimated_value.instruction: The estimated or appraised value of the individual asset item, if itemized.

total_estimated_value.instruction: The total estimated value of all declared assets on the statement.

statement_date.instruction: The date of the statement or appraisal. YYYY-MM-DD format.
